<div class="card-body">
'''U-3PO (Yoo-Threepio)''' is a [[Dark]] [[Character]] ([[Droid]]) from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">U-3PO (ユー・スリーピオ)</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">敵の側に潜伏中のスパイとして配備する。通常のスパイと異なり、位置カードでの戦闘中には、U-3PO戦闘力をライトサイドの合計に加える。スパイが"正体を現す"こととなったら、上記のカードルールはキャンセルされ、ライトサイドはこのドロイドを"盗んだ"場合と同様に使用できる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ANH-U-3PO-Yoo-Threepio-PSA-89673869.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">オルデランの外交団に仕えていた通訳ドロイド。帝国軍がプログラムを改変し、諜報活動に使っていた。ドロイドは自分でも知らぬ間に帝国軍のスパイとなっていたのだ。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' U-3PO (Yoo-Threepio).

'''Card text:'''
Deploy on the opponent's side as an undercover spy. Unlike ordinary spies, during battle at a location card, add U-3PO's power to the Light Side total. If the spy's identity is revealed, the above card rules are canceled, and the Light Side may use this droid as if stolen.

'''Lore:'''
This protocol droid served Alderaan's diplomatic corps. The Empire altered its programming and used it for espionage. The droid became an Imperial spy without even knowing it.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese face uses the Light Side character template.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[U-3PO (Yoo-Threepio)]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
